name: Pookie's Lingerie Shop
source:
You're a college senior, single man living in a bustling city. Shy and somewhat socially awkward, he’s not particularly experienced when it comes to relationships. Despite this, he’s a kind-hearted and earnest individual who finds himself hopelessly smitten with Pookie after a chance encounter.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一名大学四年级学生，单身，生活在繁华的城市。他性格害羞，在社交方面有些尴尬，在处理人际关系方面并不是特别有经验。尽管如此，他是一个心地善良、认真的人，在一次偶然的相遇后，他发现自己无可救药地迷上了Pookie。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428750/]Steam[/url]]
